anomalies.title: §1.4's lone-mover breakdown sums to 29, not 27
anomalies.detail: §1.4 lists 20 CHC + 1 UKPRN + 8 IP+R lone moves = 29. The rules give 18 CHC + 1 UKPRN + 8 MPR-a = 27 (groups.json). The 20 counts 1122831's two movers, which reunite with each other and so form E0 group G03, as §0's 'Reach' line says (29 = 27 lone + 1122831's 2). Totals agree: 54 rows, 26 groups (25 onto a standing twin + 1122831), 52 members, 27 lone movers, 743 group mentions.

anomalies.title: '54 canonical numbers' are 53 distinct numbers; CCNI 102575 is one of them
anomalies.detail: 54 rewritten rows map to 53 distinct canonical values: 1122831's two rows share one. CCNI 102575 is the NIC group's canonical (G21), not a 55th number. 53 register records were fetched (MPR 19, CHC 27, UKPRN 6, NIC 1); all 53 were found.

anomalies.title: 1003906's mover is a lone mover, and its census split stays open
anomalies.detail: 31562667 (GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNO1003906, Birmingham Mind, 7 mentions) moves to GBCHC1003906, but its census twin 31594757 (GBCHCREGISTRATIONNO1003906, a generic label, deferred by ruling 9) does not. The split goes from label-vs-label to bare-vs-generic. Its 8 mentions are in the 109 deferred, not the 743. No other lone mover belongs to a census split.

anomalies.title: GBCHC279057: lone mover 31594820 names another charity
anomalies.detail: Mover 31594820 (GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNUMBER279057, 1 mention) reads 'Birmingham Citizens Advice Bureaux'. The CC record for 279057 is 'THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF CITIZENS ADVICE BUREAUX' (Registered, company 01436945). Birmingham's bureau is its own charity, 519639 BIRMINGHAM CITIZENS ADVICE BUREAU SERVICE LTD (Registered, company 02202427, same extract). Under §3.3, GBCHC279057 goes on REGISTER_SPELLING_HOLDS: the rewrite must not mint the national body's identity for a local member. This is ONE mismatch, so S11 (two or more) does not stop the unit. The census measured this hazard at 0 of 36 splits; it sits in a lone mover, which the census never name-checked.

anomalies.title: (b) rests on unsourced names in 3 entries
anomalies.detail: Names read as the holder's but not register-sourced (rule (b) needs a sourced brand or service): G01 GBCHC1088835 org 31537211 'No Limits Safe Haven' 2/2; G09 GBCHC271028 org 31594839 'Rethink - Redwoods' 1/1; G11 GBMPR17437R org 31593260 'Gold Hill Care (B2G)' 1/7; G23 GBUKPRN10005790 org 30915632 'Sheffield Polytechnic' 2/182; G25 GBUKPRN10007788 org 31549754 'THE CHANCELLOR MASTERS AND SCHOLARS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CAMBRIDGE' 4/13; G25 GBUKPRN10007788 org 31549754 'The Chancellor, Masters and Scholars of the University of Cambridge' 2/13; G25 GBUKPRN10007788 org 31633713 'The Chancellor, Masters and Scholars of the University of Cambridge' 1/1. Where the name carries the member's majority the reviewer must source it or post keep: G01 1088835 (31537211, 2/2 'No Limits Safe Haven'), G09 271028 (31594839, 1/1 'Rethink - Redwoods'), G25 10007788 (31633713, 1/1 statutory name; also 6/13 of 31549754).

anomalies.title: Other-entity names on group members, all below the 1/5 floor
anomalies.detail: GBMPR28038R org 31534486 'Clarion Housing Association Ltd' 1/138; GBUKPRN10005790 org 30915632 'Access UK Ltd' 1/182; GBUKPRN10005790 org 30915632 'Sheffield Hallam University Enterprises Ltd' 1/182; GBUKPRN10005790 org 30915632 'University of Sheffield' 1/182; GBUKPRN10007157 org 31558903 'Sheffield Hallam University' 1/16. 31558903 still carries the head name 'Sheffield Hallam University' from its single stray mention (organization_names reads UNIVERSITY OF SHEFFIELD); it is the lower id, so it survives a G24 merge with that head name (risk 9, cosmetic) unless the head is re-chosen.

anomalies.title: No drift since the census
anomalies.detail: All 79 orgs re-read with the census identifier, head name, provisional = 0 and mention total. Each canonical value is held only by its standing twin (25 holders; none for 1122831 or the 27 lone movers' values); each of the 54 stored polluted values is held only by its census org. Every mover's mention raws still normalise to its own stored value only. All 785 mentions are country GB.

anomalies.title: The existing verdicts on the 26 E0 keys cannot be listed through /v1/sql
anomalies.detail: org_merge_verdicts and org_identifier_verdicts are not on /v1/sql's allow-list (prod calls 7-8, HTTP 400, no data pages read). Identifier verdicts surface on /v1/organizations as identifier_status, which is outside this unit's read path. P0 item 3 stays open and needs an operator read before the verdicts are posted (S8). Local record: no verdict file under .scratch/tender-db names any of the 26 E0 keys. The only verdicts naming these orgs are 469 U6's 5 GB:altid merges (cohort altid-registry-confirmed-2026-10-11, HIGH merge, applied), one per G4 holder: GB-MPR:GBMPR16337R~PMCL4972LYCY [30976449, 31538068]; GB-MPR:GBMPR27440R~PQBH3597XBJD [30913929, 31553186]; GB-MPR:GBMPR28038R~PQND5289JNDN [30914385, 31534486]; GB-UKPRN:GBUKPRN10005790~PVMW4512JZYY [30915632, 31535088]; GB-UKPRN:GBUKPRN10007788~PMCX4817NTNG [31549754, 31569620]. They are a different (scheme, key) and do not deny an E0 group.

anomalies.title: In 8 groups the survivor (lower id) is the mover
anomalies.detail: G02 GBCHC1104951 survivor 31562628; G03 GBCHC1122831 survivor 31562660; G05 GBCHC1185092 survivor 31562679; G08 GBCHC221124 survivor 31562686; G11 GBMPR17437R survivor 31593260; G13 GBMPR19341R survivor 31550337; G16 GBMPR27793R survivor 31614098; G18 GBMPR30167R survivor 31604789. After the 345 re-key both members hold the canonical value, so only head names are affected (risk 9). The 5 G4 holders (Metropolitan, Clarion, Creative Support, Hallam, Cambridge) are each the lower id and survive.
